descriptionText:
This 2018 Panini Donruss sports trading card features Javon Wims, a rookie player from the Chicago Bears team in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 391. It is a standard-sized card manufactured by Panini in 2018.

This card is perfect for any NFL fan or sports trading card collector. It has all the necessary features for a successful card, including the player's name, team, and card number. The card is not autographed, but it is still a valuable addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this Javon Wims rookie card to your collection!
